  1. 8459Ibn Abī Aws al-Thaqafīابن أبي أوس الثقفي يقال اسمه عبد الرحمن ويقال هو ابن عمرو ابن أوسNot graded
    Nisba
    الثقفي

    Ibn Ḥajar’s entry

    ابن أبي أوس الثقفي يقال اسمه عبد الرحمن ويقال هو ابن عمرو ابن أوس [روى عنه النعمان بن سالم]

    Translation

    8459. Ibn Abī Aws al-Thaqafī: said to be named ʿAbd al-Raḥmān or Ibn ʿAmr b. Aws [al-Nuʿmān b. Sālim narrated from him; the report continues on the next page].

    Abū al-Ashbāl edition adds

    روى عنه النعمان بن سالم

    Taqrīb al-Tahdhīb no. 8459, ed. ʿAwwāma, p. 686–687

    لا يعرف د وأما المتأخر فاسمهUnknown: rank 9 of 12, read from his wording
    Generation
    3rd: middle Successors

    Ibn Ḥajar’s entry

    Translation

    8500. Al-Ṭufāwī, a teacher of Abū Naḍra: unnamed and unknown, third generation. [د] As for the later man, his name was Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān.

  221. 8502Al-Najrānīالنجراني عن ابن عمرUnknown4th gen.
    Grade
    مجهولUnknown: rank 9 of 12
    Generation
    4th: Successors who mostly narrate from senior Successors
    Appears in
    Sunan Abī Dāwūd, Sunan Ibn Māja

    Ibn Ḥajar’s entry

    النجراني عن ابن عمر مجهول من الرابعة د ق

    Translation

    8502. Al-Najrānī: he transmits from Ibn ʿUmar; unknown, of the fourth generation. [د ق]
    Al-Naḥḥās [with undotted ḥāʾ]: ʿĪsā b. Muḥammad. Al-Naḥwī: Shaybān and Yazīd.
    Al-Nakhkhās, with dotted khāʾ: Mufaḍḍal b. Ṣāliḥ, al-Walīd b. Ṣāliḥ, and Muḥammad b. ʿUbayd. Al-Nakhaʿī: Ibrāhīm b. Yazīd when the name is used without specification; the designation also applies to Ḥajjāj b. Arṭāʾa, Ibrāhīm b. Suwayd, and others. Al-Nadbī: Bishr b. Ḥarb. Al-Narsī: ʿAbd al-Aʿlā b. Ḥammād and ʿAbbās b. al-Walīd. Al-Narmaqī: ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. ʿAbd Allāh. Al-Nasāʾī: Aḥmad b. Shuʿayb when used without specification; Khushaysh b. Aṣram and a group are also associated with the place. Al-Nashāʾī, with dotted shīn: Muḥammad b. Ḥarb. Al-Naṣrī: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Madanī; the designation is applied to others as well. Al-Nufaylī: ʿAbd Allāh b. Muḥammad; it is also applied to ʿAlī b. ʿUthmān and Saʿīd b. Ḥafṣ. Al-Naqqāsh: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsā. Al-Numarī: Abū ʿUmar al-Ḥawḍī. Al-Numayrī: Fuḍayl b. Sulaymān. Al-Nahdī: Abū ʿUthmān ʿAbd al-Raḥmān; others are also associated with the name. Al-Nahshalī: Abū Bakr likewise. Al-Nahmī: Qinān. Al-Nawwāʾ: an affiliation to selling date pits; his name is Kathīr. Al-Nawfalī: Yazīd b. ʿAbd al-Malik, and others. Al-Nīlī: Khālid b. Dīnār and Ibrāhīm b. al-Ḥajjāj. [Hāʾ] Al-Hāshimī: Sulaymān b. Dāwūd, and countless others. Al-Habbārī: Muḥammad b. Thawāb and ʿUbayd b. Ismāʿīl. Al-Hajarī: Abū Bakr [thus written, correctly: Abū Isḥāq], and others. Al-Harawī: Abū Zayd and others. Al-Haffānī: Ḍamḍam b. Jaws and others. Al-Haddādī: Khālid b. Yazīd and others. Al-Hudayrī: Rabīʿa b. ʿUthmān and others. Al-Hamdānī, with sukūn on the mīm: Abū Isḥāq and others. Al-Hamadhānī, with a vowel on the mīm: Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Jabbār.
    Al-Hanāʾī: Abū Shaykh. Al-Hawzanī: Abū ʿĀmir and others. Al-Hilālī: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAwn and others. [Wāw] Al-Wābiṣī: ʿAbd al-Salām. Al-Wāsiṭī: Khālid b. ʿAbd Allāh and others. Al-Wāshiḥī: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb and others. Al-Wāqidī: Muḥammad b. ʿUmar and Abū Muslim. Al-Wāqifī: Harmī [distinction]. Al-Wālibī: ʿAlī b. Rabīʿa. Al-Wuḥāẓī: Yaḥyā b. Ṣāliḥ. Al-Warrāq: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb b. al-Ḥakam. Al-Wartanīsī: Aḥmad b. Yazīd. Al-Warkānī: Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar. Al-Wazzān: Ayyūb b. Muḥammad. Al-Washshāʾ: Naṣr b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān. Al-Waṣṣābī: Luqmān b. ʿĀmir. Al-Waṣṣāfī: ʿUbayd Allāh b. al-Walīd. Al-Waʿlānī: Ibrāhīm b. Nashīṭ. Al-Waqqāṣī: ʿUthmān b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān. Al-Wakīʿī: Aḥmad b. ʿUmar b. Ḥafṣ. Al-Wahbī: Aḥmad and Muḥammad, the two sons of Khālid; also used for Aḥmad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Wahb. [Lām-Alif] Al-Lādhiqī: al-Rabīʿ b. Muḥammad b. ʿĪsā. Al-Lānī: ʿAlī b. al-Ḥasan. [Yāʾ] Al-Yāfiʿī: Muḥammad b. ʿAmr. Al-Yāmī: Zubayd and others. Al-Yaḥṣubī: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿĀmir and others. Al-Yaḥmadī: Ziyād b. al-Rabīʿ and others.

    Taqrīb al-Tahdhīb no. 8502, ed. ʿAwwāma, p. 712
